# Where this comes from

We are building an ecosystem of composable Julia packages for infectious
disease modelling. I will end with four questions for this room.

## Chains of models lose the uncertainty

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="44%"}
- Fitting models in sequence and passing estimates on is flexible, but
  uncertainty is approximated at every handover and the answers can be
  biased
- The ONS infection survey ran that way. Prevalence fed incidence,
  incidence fed $R_t$, and $R_t$ fed the variant severity analyses
- Fitting everything together avoids that, and is slower to build,
  because each model gets written from scratch

::: {.callout-important}
We know what to build. We do not have the parts to build it with.
:::
:::

## We built the modular one already

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="56%"}
- I started `epinowcast` in 2021 to be the modular one. Every
  component had a regression interface and could be switched out. It
  still cannot be taken apart into pieces anyone else can use
- The same structural request has been written down in `EpiNow2` four
  times since 2020. The two closed as done left the package no easier
  to take apart. The two still open ask for structure it cannot give
- Before it `EpiNow2`, after it `primarycensored` and `epidist`. Each
  found a real problem, fixed it, and left another package that could
  not be pulled apart
:::
::: {.column width="44%"}
::: {.callout-important}
You can reuse the package. You cannot reuse anything inside it.
:::

::: {.attribution}
Four `EpiNow2` issues read 2026-08-10 ·

:::

::::

## It is not only us

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}
- At least seven packages fit renewal models in Stan. None of them
  share a component
- The only sharing I know of anywhere is `epinowcast` copying
  `primarycensored`'s Stan source in, licence file and all. Both of
  those are mine
- The two wastewater packages, `EpiSewer` and `wwinference`, share no
  components either, and it is not clear which of their modelling
  choices matter
:::
::: {.column width="48%"}
- We wrote down a workflow for building these models, then could not
  follow it with the tools we had built. The paper gives a schematic
  case study rather than code, because the software did not exist

::: {.callout-important}
The unit of reuse is the whole package. It should be the
epidemiological concept.
:::
